steps.brief:
Add a build_recap function that takes the finalized transcript and the meeting's structured decisions and actions, and returns a short recap: decisions one line each, actions with their owners one line each, open questions one line each.
Open questions are transcript lines ending in a question mark with no answering line before the next speaker change.
If a group is empty, omit it.
steps.title: Build the recap from the transcript

steps.brief:
In the Note write path for a meeting, after the transcript is attached, call build_recap and append the result as the final section of the Note.
Nothing follows the recap in the Note.
steps.title: Append the recap to the meeting Note

steps.brief:
Unit tests: build_recap extracts decisions, actions with owners, and open questions from a sample transcript.
The Note write path appends the recap as the last section.
An empty group is omitted from the recap.
steps.title: Tests for the recap

  brief

  > Open questions are transcript lines ending in a question mark with no answering line before the next speaker change.
  > If a group is empty, omit it.

step + Append the recap to the meeting Note
  owns holdspeak/meeting_exports.py
  after 1

  after 1, 2
  brief
  > Unit tests: build_recap extracts decisions, actions with owners, and open questions from a sample transcript.
  > The Note write path appends the recap as the last section.
  > An empty group is omitted from the recap.

program Programs window exports to a Note
  goal
  > The Programs window should export the list to a new Note, one line per program with its state.
  in app · main · project HoldSpeak
  template fast cycle
  control normal
  check scripts/quick_check.sh
  budget 64k

at the end
  R+ check: `scripts/quick_check.sh` is green
  R+ word: The exported Note reads as a clean list: one program per line, state visible at a glance.

step + Export button in the Programs window
  owns web/src/desk/programs/ProgramsWindow.tsx
  brief
  > Add an Export to Note action in the Programs window toolbar.
  > On click it calls the backend to create a new Note from the current program list.
  > The button is disabled when there are no programs.

step + Create the Note from the program list
  owns holdspeak/kernel/program_ops.py
  after 1
  brief
  > Add an export_to_note function that reads the current program list and creates a new Note whose body is one line per program: the program title followed by its state.
  > The Note is titled with the project name and the export date.

step + Tests for the export
  owns tests/unit/test_program_window_words.py
  after 1, 2
  brief
  > Unit tests: export_to_note produces one line per program with its state.
  > The Note title carries the project name and date.
  > An empty program list produces a Note with no body lines.
